markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class set and high reliability, but only 3 of 5 neighbors agree; input is JPEG-degraded.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive >99%, InSitu <1% | Very high, one class |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 96th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 Invasive | Moderate; two InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 4) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical; linked to invasion in concept model [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Near-typical score; minor term in concept model · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Typical score; failed AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown faithful. Normal lobules unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- JPEG degradation altered stromal or nuclear texture the models read.
- In situ disease with reactive stroma mimics invasion; 2 of 5 neighbors are InSitu.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4** — confirm stromal invasion versus in situ growth.
2. **Regions 3, 10, 11** — check tubule and duct areas for benign glands.
3. **Region 2** — lowest region invasive score (2%); confirm tissue type.
